scientific.integrity: The claim separates a symbolic all-function proof from finite exhaustive verification, excludes the known complete-multipartite scalar minimum from novelty, and records both access and public-date uncertainty explicitly.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite verifier covers order at most 9; arbitrary order is justified by the symbolic proof.
The signed Roman domination number of complete multipartite graphs is prior-covered and is not claimed as new.
The full text of Yin and Chen (2017) was not obtained, leaving residual risk that it contains an equivalent structural lemma even though its published target is the scalar minimum.
The founding full text bears 2012 copyright/date-only evidence, while the exact-day public bibliographic date verified in this run is 2014-04-08; no earlier exact day was invented.

title: Weight enumerator of signed Roman dominating functions on complete multipartite graphs
